استنقذت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْقَذْتُ (istanqaḏtu) /is.tan.qað.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# اِسْتَنْقَذْتَ (istanqaḏta) /is.tan.qað.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# اِسْتَنْقَذْتِ (istanqaḏti) /is.tan.qað.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# اِسْتَنْقَذَتْ (istanqaḏat) /is.t
